instruction: Candid documentary medium shot of a cozy indoor living room. On a yellow couch, the person with short curly hair and glasses (R1) sits cross-legged on the right, holding a pen and looking at their companion. On the left, the person with short dark hair in the green sweatshirt (R2) gestures with one hand while holding a document and looking at R1. They sit side-by-side, discussing the paper over a wooden coffee table in the foreground holding a laptop and a cup of black coffee. Warm, soft indoor lighting illuminates the scene with natural tones.
